subject: High School and Vocational Capital Planning
overview: The School Committee reviewed a capital plan report following a tour of high school and vocational facilities and received updates on public health testing and pedestrian safety.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from October 17, 2016, along with bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Capital Plan Committee of the Whole Report
items.summary: The committee accepted a report on the October 24 tour of the high school and vocational school, which identified priorities such as a library redesign and the relocation of the culinary arts program.

items.title: Crossing Guard Safety Update
items.summary: The committee voted to send a letter to the Department of Conservation and Recreation requesting that a safety evaluation for crossing guards at Fulton Street and Fellsway be conducted during a full school week.

items.title: Italian Scholarship Awards
items.summary: Students Joshua Crespo and Lina Zian were recognized for receiving $1,000 scholarships from the Federazione Associazione Abruzzese USA for excellence in Italian studies.

items.title: Monthly Financial Report
items.summary: The Director of Finance and Administration presented a budget update noting that the new online payment system has collected an estimated $1.4 million in its first year.

items.title: Professional Development Day Preview
items.summary: Administrators outlined the upcoming teacher-driven professional development day focused on social-emotional learning and approved a motion to provide lunch for teachers at future sessions.

items.title: College Fair Report
items.summary: The superintendent reported that the October 26 college fair featured 88 institutions and included special sessions regarding transition plans for students with special needs.

items.title: Tuberculosis Testing Update
items.summary: The committee received a report on the screening of nearly 200 students and staff following a potential tuberculosis exposure, with a follow-up testing round planned for January.

items.title: Vocational School Report and Conference Approval
items.summary: The committee approved an overnight trip for students to attend a state leadership conference in Marlborough and received an update on the recent vocational advisory board meeting.

items.title: Mock Election and Domestic Violence Awareness Video
items.summary: The committee discussed high school mock election results and recognized a student-produced video against domestic violence that will be used in regional wellness workshops.
